ai_summary: A dark-themed scrolling gallery component that uses CSS sticky positioning combined with Lenis smooth scrolling to create an immersive scroll experience. Features a grid-based image layout with subtle grid pattern background, transition effects on images, and a full-screen sticky hero section. Ideal for creative portfolios, media galleries, or product showcases requiring engaging scroll-driven interactions.
